title: Lands no longer needed.
bodyText: Lands acquired by the authority from another government agency that are no longer needed by the authority for the program shall be returned to the previous owner of those lands. Lands acquired by the authority from a private party that are owned by the authority and designated for the program but are subsequently no longer needed for the program shall be retained by the authority.
bodyHtml: [§206E-291]  Lands no longer needed.  Lands acquired by the authority from another government agency that are no longer needed by the authority for the program shall be returned to the previous owner of those lands.  Lands acquired by the authority from a private party that are owned by the authority and designated for the program but are subsequently no longer needed for the program shall be retained by the authority. [L 2023, c 97, pt of §3]
